(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a __Young’s modulus below 100MPa/__ and having a Young's modulus selected from the group consisting of silicones and other materials.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) __is selected from the group consisting of silicones.__

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2), __wherein the elastomer is selected from the group consisting of silicones and other materials.__

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) __is selected from the group consisting of silicones.__
